names.legendary: Duchess Julienne, the Thousand Cuts

lore.common: Roars for five seconds, pulverises one innocent carrot and insists it has done a full day's work.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to start until the lid clicks exactly three times. Even its owner has forgotten the secret handshake.
lore.rare: Slices vegetables into perfect cubes, then rearranges them into rude little messages on the cutting board.
lore.epic: Whirled so fiercely at the banquet that every onion in the kingdom began crying. The guests assumed it was a beautiful speech.
lore.legendary: Created a salad so exquisitely chopped that the royal chef declared himself obsolete. Duchess Julienne replaced him with a carrot wearing a tiny toque.

names.legendary: Beatrix, the Whipped-Cream Empress

lore.common: Buzzes through cake batter until every nearby shirt has its own little polka dots.
lore.uncommon: Launches a single blob of batter across the kitchen, always onto the cleanest thing in sight.
lore.rare: Whips cream so fast that the bowl develops a tiny snowdrift, complete with one frozen strawberry.
lore.epic: Whipped a mountain of meringue at the royal feast. The guests needed ladders to find the pudding.
lore.legendary: Beatrix once whisked the sea into a foam so light that ships floated above the waves. Sailors still search for the island of perfectly stiff peaks.

names.legendary: Churnhilda, Mother of Winter Scoops

lore.common: Takes an hour to churn ice cream and five minutes to eat it. Calls this efficient.
lore.uncommon: Demands that its bowl be frozen overnight, then pretends it has never met the freezer.
lore.rare: Churns any fruit into a flavour that matches its owner's happiest summer memory.
lore.epic: Worked through a heatwave until the whole paddling pool froze solid. The neighbourhood opened a skating school in July.
lore.legendary: Churnhilda made a single scoop to cool a feverish dragon. In gratitude, the dragon breathed winter into her bowl, and she has never run out of ice cream since.

names.legendary: Pulpwick, Lord of the Last Drop

lore.common: Spits orange pulp into every corner of the kitchen except the pulp container.
lore.uncommon: Needs twenty minutes of cleaning to produce thirty seconds of juice. It considers this fair.
lore.rare: Extracts the last drop from fruit, vegetables and accidentally one very unfortunate cucumber.
lore.epic: Went into overdrive at the harvest festival and sprayed fresh juice across the entire stage. The musicians smelled of grapefruit for a week.
lore.legendary: Pulpwick squeezed the first lemon of spring so fiercely that it filled a dry village fountain. The children still come there each year carrying enormous straws.

names.legendary: Kneadora, Queen of the Endless Loaf

lore.common: Puffs flour into a chef's face as soon as the lid comes off.
lore.uncommon: Walks across the counter while kneading, trying to escape with the entire mixing bowl.
lore.rare: Can knead a loaf so springy that it bounces out of the oven and lands on the table already sliced.
lore.epic: Whipped cake batter into a towering spiral that rose through the roof and iced the passing clouds.
lore.legendary: Kneadora kneaded the first loaf from the dust of a meteor. Whoever eats one crumb can remember every kitchen in which they have ever felt at home.

names.legendary: Bowlder, Mouth of the Endless Feast

lore.common: Stays perfectly still until you carry it across a clean carpet. Then it practises waves.
lore.uncommon: Rings like a ceremonial gong whenever someone puts down a spoon.
lore.rare: Swallows a whole soup serving and gives back only the peas. Chefs are investigating.
lore.epic: Spilled enough enchanted porridge to cover the village green. The children used the hill of oats for sledging.
lore.legendary: Its ancient ceramic belly contains every breakfast ever skipped. Explorers once descended for the first pancake and returned holding a tiny submarine.

names.legendary: Strainoth, Keeper of the Hundred Holes

lore.common: Lets one macaroni slip into the sink every time dinner is made. Keeps score.
lore.uncommon: Wears itself as a helmet during playtime. The noodles are not impressed.
lore.rare: Can summon a fog of steam from a single wet spaghetti strand.
lore.epic: Drained an entire canal through its hundred holes and caught everything but the pasta it was looking for. The fish have filed complaints.
lore.legendary: Strainoth once filtered the tears of a rain god into pure golden soup. The god still visits to ask why every storm leaves one lonely pea behind.

names.legendary: Rinsalora, Basin of the Cleansed Harvest

lore.common: Drips exactly one cold drop down your sleeve after you've finished rinsing.
lore.uncommon: Keeps fruit stickers and loses the strawberries. It may have priorities.
lore.rare: Washes mud from carrots so thoroughly that they forget they ever grew underground.
lore.epic: Sprayed a thousand glittering streams across the banquet hall and created a rainbow that refused to leave until pudding.
lore.legendary: Rinsalora's bowl holds the first rain that fell upon the world's first garden. All fruit washed in it ripens perfectly, except bananas, which it has never understood.

names.legendary: Sifrella, Who Separates the Impossible

lore.common: Catches exactly one stubborn flour lump and refuses to let it pass.
lore.uncommon: Shakes so hard that the baker ends up wearing a white moustache.
lore.rare: Sifts the sugar from the salt and the truth from the gossip without changing a single grain.
lore.epic: Sent a cloud of flour through the palace kitchens that covered the cooks like powdered ghosts. The king ordered a second batch of biscuits anyway.
lore.legendary: Sifrella held the sands of time in a silver mesh and let only the happiest moments slip through. The others remain in her little kitchen tin until someone is ready for them.

names.legendary: Meshara, Who Separated Rain from Sky

lore.common: Catches all the tea leaves but lets exactly one escape into the guest's cup.
lore.uncommon: Hangs off the rim of a mug until someone sneezes, then dives in after the biscuit.
lore.rare: Separates anything poured through it into the precious bits and the things nobody wanted, including the raisins in a cake.
lore.epic: Strained the entire river during the village fair and caught every missing wedding ring, fishing hook and rubber duck in one enormous mesh.
lore.legendary: Meshara sifted the first rainstorm through a silver net so every droplet reached the thirsty roots below. The clouds still thank her before they burst.

names.legendary: Grindelthor, Eater of the First Morning

lore.common: Starts roaring the moment somebody whispers let's not wake anyone.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a perfect dusting of grounds where the kitchen was clean five seconds ago.
lore.rare: Can grind a single bean into a thundercloud of coffee dust. The kettle takes this as a personal challenge.
lore.epic: Awoke at six and shook the entire apartment block with its burrs. Every resident arrived downstairs carrying an empty mug and an accusation.
lore.legendary: Grindelthor's millstones were carved from mountains that never slept. His darkest roast can wake the dead tired, though it tastes suspiciously like burnt disappointment.

names.legendary: Cumula Foamus, Sovereign of Soft Clouds

lore.common: Buzzes beneath the coffee and builds a tiny milk moustache on the cup.
lore.uncommon: Flicks froth onto the kitchen tiles just as someone finishes cleaning them.
lore.rare: Whips a perfect miniature cloud from the last drop of milk, then lets it float over the breakfast table.
lore.epic: Turned the cafe's milk supply into a mountain of foam. The customers climbed it for a view of the pastry counter.
lore.legendary: Cumula Foamus taught the winter clouds to gather without making rain. In return, every froth-topped coffee bears a tiny portrait of the sky.

names.legendary: Carbonara, Mother of a Million Bubbles

lore.common: Gurgles dramatically at a glass of tap water as though it were performing an experiment.
lore.uncommon: Adds so much fizz to one bottle that its lid requests a parachute.
lore.rare: Gives every drink a different personality. The lemonade is loud; the cucumber water thinks it's royalty.
lore.epic: Carbonated the village fountain until the statues began burping and the ducks floated three inches above the water.
lore.legendary: Carbonara was the first creature to teach spring water how to laugh. Every sparkling stream in the mountains still carries a little of her mischief.

names.legendary: Mortabella, Grinder of Lost Kingdoms

lore.common: Gets stuck on the very last peppercorn, then suddenly launches it into somebody's soup.
lore.uncommon: Sneezes freshly ground pepper into the cook's face and asks if the flavour is strong enough.
lore.rare: Grinds a single cinnamon stick into fragrant dust that makes the entire bakery levitate an inch.
lore.epic: Cranked out a whirling spice storm over the food festival, seasoning every dish at once. The ice-cream stall is still recovering.
lore.legendary: Mortabella ground the royal wedding's last saffron threads into golden dust. The guests danced for seven nights, and none could remember who married whom.

names.legendary: Aquellia, the Last Clear Drop

lore.common: Promises a fresh glass of water but insists on dripping one drop at a time.
lore.uncommon: Quietly complains when someone forgets to refill it.
lore.rare: Filters a muddy drink until even the lemonade looks suspiciously transparent.
lore.epic: Filtered an entire paddling pool so clear that the children kept trying to dive into what looked like empty air.
lore.legendary: Carried the last clean water across a poisoned wasteland inside its fragile walls. Each sip made the soil beneath it green, until rain returned to the land.

names.legendary: Forkulon, the Four-Pronged Oracle

lore.common: Pokes the last chip on the plate three times before admitting it wanted to eat it all along.
lore.uncommon: Hunts the last pea on the plate with the focus of a knight seeking a dragon. Usually loses.
lore.rare: Can twirl an entire pot of spaghetti onto one tine. The pasta council has issued a restraining order.
lore.epic: Its royal banquet duel lasted three days because each combatant kept stopping to taste the gravy.
lore.legendary: The Four-Pronged Oracle can predict any future except where the last clean fork has gone. Entire kingdoms have fallen over this breakfast mystery.

names.legendary: Glacius, Keeper of Forgotten Dinners

lore.common: Hums contentedly over a kingdom of frozen peas and the fish fingers nobody has claimed since 2019.
lore.uncommon: Forms a thick moat of ice around the lid whenever someone wants a single fish finger.
lore.rare: Safeguards leftovers from five birthdays ago. The frozen lasagna is now considered an archaeological find.
lore.epic: A power cut thawed its secret collection of winter weather. The kitchen experienced six snowstorms and one inexplicable penguin.
lore.legendary: An entire prehistoric winter sleeps beneath Glacius's lid. One day the door will open and the last mammoth will ask whether the peas are ready.

names.legendary: Cubert, Architect of the Crystal Igloo

lore.common: Drops one ice cube into its tray at midnight, convincing everyone the house is haunted.
lore.uncommon: Makes exactly enough cubes for the people who didn't want any.
lore.rare: Stacks ice into perfectly square towers that refuse to melt even beside hot tea.
lore.epic: Overflowed at a summer wedding and covered the dance floor with ice cubes. The first dance became a spectacular slide.
lore.legendary: Cubert once built a palace from clear ice in the heart of the hottest desert. Travellers still find a cool drink waiting at its gates.

names.legendary: Sir Chillingham of the Hidden Feast

lore.common: Hums beside the bed with one lonely yoghurt and several ambitious plans.
lore.uncommon: Opens itself at midnight whenever someone whispers 'I'm not hungry'.
lore.rare: Keeps a single forbidden chocolate bar perfectly cold through a summer heatwave.
lore.epic: Became the headquarters of the dormitory's midnight feast, distributing snacks from a hidden shelf nobody could explain.
lore.legendary: Sir Chillingham once fed the guests of an entire palace from a cabinet smaller than a nightstand. The kitchen chefs still insist there must have been a secret door.

names.legendary: Seraphine of the Last Vintage

lore.common: Hums in the kitchen like a sleepy bumblebee guarding six bottles.
lore.uncommon: Frosts its glass door whenever someone tries to count the bottles inside.
lore.rare: Can preserve the scent of a summer vineyard through the deepest winter; opening its door releases a single warm breeze.
lore.epic: Countess Permafrost froze an entire ballroom's drinks in the middle of a heatwave. Guests danced in scarves; the penguin-shaped ice sculpture became mayor.
lore.legendary: Seraphine stores one perfect autumn afternoon between her shelves. Every hundred years she opens the cooler, and the vines outside remember how to bear their very first grapes.

names.legendary: Panthalassa, the Bottomless Skillet

lore.common: Greets every knob of butter with a loud sizzle. Thinks the cooker is its personal applause machine.
lore.uncommon: Flicks a drop of butter at anyone who calls cooking easy.
lore.rare: Flips eggs with a magician's flourish and never catches the second one. The cat keeps score.
lore.epic: Won a duel against a famous chef by flipping one pancake over the castle wall and catching it on the other side.
lore.legendary: In the oldest kitchens, Panthalassa is said to fry the sunrise itself. Once it overslept and the world endured an extra hour of night.

names.legendary: Sir Slicewell, the Gentle Blade

lore.common: Peeks out of the knife block just enough to make the wooden spoons nervous.
lore.uncommon: Slices bread neatly until it reaches the last piece, then tears off a mountainous chunk.
lore.rare: Cuts a tomato into slices so thin they can be used as tiny stained-glass windows.
lore.epic: Carved the royal roast into exactly enough slices for every guest, then made one extra for the dog without anyone noticing.
lore.legendary: Sir Slicewell was forged to divide any feast fairly. When two kings fought over a banquet, it sliced the table straight down the middle and left the pudding untouched.

names.legendary: Panifer, Lord of the Midnight Bakery

lore.common: Thumps through the night like somebody attempting to repair a tractor inside a cupboard.
lore.uncommon: Beeps just as the film reaches its best scene, then refuses to say which programme has finished.
lore.rare: Bakes bread shaped like whatever it dreamed of. The bicycle loaf needed a helmet.
lore.epic: Overfed its yeast until a wave of dough flooded the hallway and settled on the sofa. The family now sleeps on a very soft baguette.
lore.legendary: Every midnight, Panifer kneads tomorrow's sunrise into a golden loaf. The birds know dawn is near when the chimney smells of fresh crust.

names.legendary: Auretoast, the Golden Furnace of Morning

lore.common: Can toast an entire dinner in a box barely larger than a shoe. Always burns the smallest corner.
lore.uncommon: Pings so softly that breakfast is discovered next Tuesday.
lore.rare: Makes one side of a sandwich golden and the other side pale. It calls this artistic contrast.
lore.epic: Toasted three thousand cheese sandwiches for a school sleepover. The smell woke the parents, the neighbours and a passing delivery driver who joined the queue.
lore.legendary: Its tiny oven once turned a plain crumpet into a second sun. The garden sunflowers switched allegiance immediately, and the real sun sulked until tea.

names.legendary: Fornax, Forge of the First Margherita

lore.common: Glows orange and makes every neighbour suddenly wonder about dinner.
lore.uncommon: Cooks a perfect pizza in seconds, then burns the next one just to stay unpredictable.
lore.rare: Breathes a little flame that crisps every crust evenly. The toppings have begun arguing over who gets the warmest spot.
lore.epic: Fired pizzas so quickly that they formed a glowing tower above the garden. The fire brigade arrived hungry and stayed for dessert.
lore.legendary: Fornax baked the first pizza at the mouth of an ancient volcano. Its embers have never cooled, and each century a traveller finds them and carries the recipe home.

names.legendary: Porcellius, Dish of the Thousand Feasts

lore.common: Always keeps one stubborn smear of sauce after washing up.
lore.uncommon: Hides its chipped edge behind the parsley whenever there are important guests.
lore.rare: Makes a humble sandwich look like a royal meal. The chef has developed a considerable ego.
lore.epic: Spun above the royal table carrying an entire feast without spilling one pea. The jugglers resigned and became waiters.
lore.legendary: Porcellius served a feast for a thousand guests, with every portion appearing at the perfect moment. Only the king received broccoli; he had refused his vegetables as a boy.

names.legendary: Cauldrona, Mother of a Thousand Suppers

lore.common: Bubbles so loudly the cook has to ask permission to speak.
lore.uncommon: Boils over the exact moment somebody says, It will be fine.
lore.rare: Brews arguments into soup. One spoonful makes even polite guests bring up the inheritance.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire wedding banquet and cooked it into one enormous stew. The bride's aunt still complains about the seasoning.
lore.legendary: Its bottomless belly has fed lost travellers for centuries. The price of a meal is a story; bad storytellers get turned into dishwashers.

names.legendary: Potcrust, Guardian of Winter

lore.common: Breathes a little puff of gravy through the holes in its pastry lid.
lore.uncommon: Bubbles furiously whenever a hungry guest tries to peek beneath the crust.
lore.rare: Keeps its filling hot until the very last spoonful, even after the kitchen fires have gone out.
lore.epic: Expanded its golden crust into a great domed shelter during a winter storm. The villagers stayed warm and ate their way through the walls.
lore.legendary: Potcrust baked its pastry into a roof over a mountain village during the longest snowstorm on record. Each spring the villagers still replace the tiles with fresh crust.

names.legendary: Calderon, Keeper of the Hearthfire

lore.common: Gurgles in the cupboard like a grumpy ghost making tea.
lore.uncommon: Shows a tiny red light and refuses to work until somebody whispers the correct pressure.
lore.rare: Chooses the precise moment you enter the shower to announce an unexpected ice age.
lore.epic: Roared back to life after a winter breakdown and made every radiator sing in harmony. The neighbours requested an encore and thicker curtains.
lore.legendary: Calderon keeps the first fire ever lit hidden in his copper heart. When winter knocks at the door, even the coldest stone remembers the sun.

names.legendary: Emberquilt, Guardian of the Long Night

lore.common: Preheats the wrong half of the bed and acts surprised.
lore.uncommon: Knows the exact moment a cold foot enters and immediately turns itself off.
lore.rare: Can warm a bed before its owner even starts thinking about sleep. The cat has discovered this.
lore.epic: Turned an entire snowed-in inn into a tropical paradise overnight. The guests woke in sunglasses, and the snowman booked a room.
lore.legendary: When the longest winter stole the village hearths, Emberquilt wrapped the sleeping children in a gentle glow until spring returned. Its warmth still waits beneath cold sheets.

names.legendary: Velvet Voltara, Weaver of Warm Dreams

lore.common: Always tangles around the cord at exactly the wrong moment.
lore.uncommon: Insists on being washed separately, as if it were royalty.
lore.rare: Keeps a secret pocket of warmth even when the blanket underneath is cold.
lore.epic: Wrapped the entire guest bed in such perfect comfort that the visiting relatives refused to leave. The family now charges rent by the nap.
lore.legendary: Velvet Voltara tucked the entire winter fog beneath its cover and served it tea. The mountains enjoyed six weeks of sunshine, and the ski resorts threatened legal action.

names.legendary: Thermorath, Warden of the Last Hearth

lore.common: Warms the cat first. Everyone else waits.
lore.uncommon: Smells like toasted dust for the first ten minutes of winter and calls it nostalgia.
lore.rare: Can make a chilly office feel like a desert, but only beside the manager's chair.
lore.epic: Seized the thermostat during a snowstorm and declared itself winter's new ruler. By lunch the staff were working in shorts and sunglasses.
lore.legendary: Thermorath won the town election by heating the council chamber during a blizzard. Its first official decree banned cold pizza; its second abolished winter on weekdays.

names.legendary: Furnacius, Heart of the Winter Keep

lore.common: Wakes beneath the house with a grumpy roar and blows warm air at whoever complained about the cold last.
lore.uncommon: Blows warm air into the wrong room and insists bedrooms are a luxury.
lore.rare: Sends gusts through the vents that arrange the curtains into dramatic battle flags.
lore.epic: Roared during the town's coldest night and turned every snowflake over the rooftops to steam. The children demanded refunds.
lore.legendary: In the deepest frost, Furnacius keeps the last hearth of a forgotten castle burning. Its embers glow with the names of every family it has sheltered.

names.legendary: Ignatia, the Winter's Warm Heart

lore.common: Clicks three times before lighting its blue flame, like a tiny dragon clearing its throat.
lore.uncommon: Clicks several times before lighting, as though thinking very hard about the weather.
lore.rare: Warms the person furthest away and leaves the owner shivering in front of it.
lore.epic: Kept an outdoor banquet warm through a blizzard. The guests complained only that their ice cream melted.
lore.legendary: Ignatia's blue flame was taken from a star that fell into the snow. Every winter she brings warmth to the lost, provided they stop asking her to cook marshmallows.

names.legendary: Nana Ember, Keeper of Winter Hugs

lore.common: Curls around a chilly shoulder like a small, very warm housecat.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to cool down until every member of the family has had a turn.
lore.rare: Chases an ache out of a tired back so thoroughly that the owner forgets why they sat down.
lore.epic: Heated every seat in the village hall during a snowstorm. The audience stayed for three extra performances just to remain cosy.
lore.legendary: Nana Ember comforted an ancient traveller through the coldest mountain night. Where the pad rested, the snow melted into the first wildflowers of spring.

names.legendary: Finnegan, Hearth of the Long Night

lore.common: Spends twenty minutes warming its fins and one second telling you to move your socks.
lore.uncommon: Clicks through the evening like a metal cricket with a very comfortable pension.
lore.rare: Keeps the room cosy long after the power goes out. The blankets have begun taking credit.
lore.epic: Took so long to heat the village hall that winter ended first. Once warm, it accidentally started a second summer.
lore.legendary: Finnegan sat beside a snowbound inn through forty nights without fuel, keeping its last ember alive. Spring arrived to find every traveller asleep and the frost politely waiting outside.

names.legendary: Caldor, the Heart Beneath the Baths

lore.common: Rumbles whenever someone tries to enjoy a quiet bath.
lore.uncommon: Saves its coldest surprise for the last person in the shower.
lore.rare: Heats a full tub before the bath toys can get organised.
lore.epic: Filled every bath in a boarding school at once. The steam drifted out of the windows and formed a fluffy cloud shaped like a rubber duck.
lore.legendary: Kept an ancient mountain refuge warm through a winter when the hot springs froze. Its last ember still sings inside the pipes whenever travellers need shelter.

names.legendary: Crispion, Lord of the Golden Crunch

lore.common: Steals the final chip from its own basket. Nobody has ever caught its tiny crispy hands.
lore.uncommon: Whooshes hot air around the kitchen while claiming it is "technically not frying". Nobody asked.
lore.rare: Can turn broccoli into something children voluntarily eat. Its secret is guarded more fiercely than a dragon's hoard.
lore.epic: Turned the entire village harvest into perfect chips with one furious gust. The potatoes have demanded royalty payments.
lore.legendary: Crisped a thundercloud and served the first storm fries to the gods. Zeus abandoned lightning for dipping sauce.

names.legendary: Frythos, Patron Saint of the Last Chip

lore.common: Steals one fry from every basket and blames the cook.
lore.uncommon: Makes the entire kitchen smell like yesterday's chips. Calls it an encore.
lore.rare: Turns soggy leftovers into perfect crispy snacks, then charges admission.
lore.epic: Launched a storm of golden chips across the high street. The local pigeons elected it mayor before the council could object.
lore.legendary: In the age before kitchens, Frythos taught fire how to make food worth eating. Even the gods returned for seconds, despite being warned about the oil.

names.legendary: Ovencius, Master of the Perfect Dawn

lore.common: Beeps so loudly it wakes everybody except the person making breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Never agrees with the instructions on the egg carton.
lore.rare: Can tell whether an egg is runny by listening to its shell. The chickens demand privacy.
lore.epic: Cooked a thousand eggs to exactly the same softness for the royal banquet. The king demanded one harder, and it resigned on the spot.
lore.legendary: Ovencius was gifted one grain of time by the Morning Star. With it, the old master can make the perfect breakfast for anyone who has ever missed the dawn.

names.legendary: Whistlora, Matriarch of the Sealed Feast

lore.common: Hisses at the vegetables as if they owe it money.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to open its lid until everybody has politely complimented the carrots.
lore.rare: Turns tough beans tender in a blink and then demands a victory whistle.
lore.epic: Cooked a hundred-course banquet in a minute. The steam launched the kitchen chimney into next Tuesday.
lore.legendary: Whistlora sealed the last winter harvest inside her iron belly and fed a frozen kingdom for seven years. She still insists on releasing the pressure before accepting thanks.

names.legendary: Koshihara, Master of the Sacred Grain

lore.common: Clicks to KEEP WARM with the dramatic flourish of a king opening parliament.
lore.uncommon: Guards the last spoonful of rice in its pot as if it were buried treasure.
lore.rare: Cooks perfect fluffy rice even when someone adds the wrong amount of water, then lectures the cook.
lore.epic: Whistled steam through the banquet hall and produced enough rice to build a full-sized snow fort. The guests had a food fight with chopsticks.
lore.legendary: Koshihara cooked rice so perfectly that the mountain gods descended for seconds. They still arrive every Sunday carrying their own chopsticks.

names.legendary: Crockmora, the Feast That Waited

lore.common: Starts dinner at breakfast and asks everyone to stop opening its lid to check.
lore.uncommon: Fills the entire building with the smell of stew, attracting three neighbours and a delivery driver.
lore.rare: Turns the toughest carrot into buttery perfection while the cook is at work.
lore.epic: Simmered a feast for an entire wedding party without a chef present. When the guests arrived, the stew greeted them by name.
lore.legendary: Crockmora guarded a winter hearth for a hundred years, turning whatever travellers brought into food enough for one more guest. The pot never boiled over and nobody left hungry.

names.legendary: Vaporette, the Gentle Cloud Cook

lore.common: Steams up the cook's glasses until the dumplings must be found by touch.
lore.uncommon: Puts the vegetables to sleep beneath its lid, then wakes them with a delicious little hiss.
lore.rare: Makes vegetables so tender that even the stubborn broccoli offers to be eaten.
lore.epic: Released a billowing steam cloud at the banquet that carried every dumpling around the room like a tiny hot-air balloon.
lore.legendary: Vaporette learned to cook from the mist that rises over mountain lakes. Her food holds the warmth of a summer morning, even in the depths of winter.

names.legendary: Thermia, the Dawn Cultivator

lore.common: Hums through the night while everyone forgets what it is making.
lore.uncommon: Guards its little jars so fiercely that nobody dares sneak an early taste.
lore.rare: Can coax shy cultures into making yogurt from milk that refused to thicken for anyone else.
lore.epic: Empress Incubella turned the town dairy into a midnight yogurt festival. Every pot finished at exactly dawn, and the cows queued to inspect the results.
lore.legendary: Thermia preserved a spoonful of the first village starter culture through centuries of cold winters. Each generation borrows a little and passes the living recipe to the next.

names.legendary: The Crimson Mitt of a Thousand Rounds

lore.common: Makes its wearer incapable of opening a crisp packet. It regards this as character building.
lore.uncommon: Knots its laces just as the bell rings, forcing a very polite delay to the fight.
lore.rare: Bounces off a punching bag so fiercely that the bag starts throwing practice punches back.
lore.epic: Won a championship by punching every incoming punch into a neat row of harmless red balloons. The audience demanded a balloon animal encore.
lore.legendary: Forged for a champion who refused to stay down, the Crimson Mitt still swings when nobody is wearing it. It never hits first, but always gets the last round.

names.legendary: Sir Grabbington, Hand of the Hearth

lore.common: Hides one of its fingers in the lining so every hot tray becomes a wrestling match.
lore.uncommon: Has a scorch mark from the famous incident involving the Sunday pudding.
lore.rare: Grabs a burning casserole without feeling the heat. Its wearer still cannot pick up a teaspoon.
lore.epic: Caught a falling feast of fifty roasting pans with one padded thumb. The cooks declared it kitchen royalty and immediately asked it to do the washing-up.
lore.legendary: Sir Grabbington carried the last glowing coal through a snowstorm, protecting it beneath his padded palm until a forgotten village found its fire again.

names.legendary: Flipsandra, Queen of the Golden Arc

lore.common: Licks every last bit of cake mix from the bowl, then denies having a tongue.
lore.uncommon: Leaves one tiny melted silicone corner in the pan as proof it has been on an adventure.
lore.rare: Can flip pancakes through walls and have them land butter-side-up on plates in other houses.
lore.epic: Flipped the entire breakfast buffet into the air and landed every omelette on the correct customer's head. Nobody complained about the garnish.
lore.legendary: Flipsandra taught the sun to turn over at dusk. Every morning she checks that it has cooked evenly before raising it back into the sky.

names.legendary: Maestro Poptavius of the Kernels

lore.common: Whirrs loudly, then fires the first piece of popcorn clear across the kitchen.
lore.uncommon: Launches kernels into every corner except the bowl placed beneath its spout.
lore.rare: Coats each fluffy piece in a perfect swirl of melted butter, leaving no greasy fingerprints.
lore.epic: Filled an entire village square with warm popcorn during the film festival. The cinema manager simply moved the screen outdoors.
lore.legendary: Maestro Poptavius turned one handful of corn into a feast for a starving travelling circus. Its machine kept popping until every performer, horse and elephant had eaten.

names.legendary: Paninora, Forge of the Golden Triangle

lore.common: Seals the bread perfectly and lets every bit of melted cheese escape at the sides.
lore.uncommon: Keeps one corner so hot that nobody is allowed to bite it before tomorrow.
lore.rare: Turns two scraps of bread into a glowing golden pocket packed with mysteriously delicious fillings.
lore.epic: Clamped every sandwich in the cafe into one enormous toasted triangle. The mayor was served a corner the size of a sofa.
lore.legendary: Paninora pressed the first toasted sandwich between two plates of enchanted iron. Its golden crust was so perfect that the royal treasury tried to use it as currency.

names.legendary: Aerowhisk, the Cloud Confectioner

lore.common: Keeps one stubborn blob of batter trapped in its wires.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against the mixing bowl as though announcing a royal arrival.
lore.rare: Whips eggs into towering peaks that refuse to collapse.
lore.epic: Whirled a thousand bowls of cream into one enormous edible cloud. The bakery's customers had to queue with stepladders.
lore.legendary: Beat the sea foam into a cloud so soft that the migrating birds rested on it. When the wind scattered the cloud, the waves smelled faintly of vanilla for a hundred years.

names.legendary: Lasagnor, the Ninefold Feast

lore.common: Lurks beneath the cheese, waiting for somebody to scrape its favourite crispy corner.
lore.uncommon: Claims all burnt-on sauce as treasure. Archaeologists now excavate it between dinners.
lore.rare: Keeps its lasagne molten until the next century. One impatient fork has been preserved in the top layer.
lore.epic: Grew walls of bubbling pasta so high that the family dinner required scaffolding and a planning permit.
lore.legendary: Its nine sacred layers never end. An explorer reached the seventh and returned with a basil crown, three recipes and no memory of Tuesday.

names.legendary: Lord Crumbleslab, Oven Titan

lore.common: Steals one chocolate chip from every biscuit before anyone notices. Blames the dog.
lore.uncommon: Bangs inside the oven like a haunted gong. The timer has started answering back.
lore.rare: Twists its metal spine to turn perfectly round cookies into little edible boomerangs.
lore.epic: Baked a biscuit large enough to cover the school playground. The headteacher called it a structural improvement.
lore.legendary: Every eclipse is merely Crumbleslab sliding another celestial cookie out of its oven. The Moon is still stuck to the greaseproof paper.

names.legendary: Emberon, Lord of the Eternal Cookout

lore.common: Steals the first sausage off every grill, then watches everyone blame the dog.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long to light that the guests finish the crisps and start discussing breakfast.
lore.rare: Sends a trail of smoke after the one person who changes seats. It calls this targeted advertising.
lore.epic: Turned a neighbourhood barbecue into a smoke-shrouded kingdom. The mayor was last seen negotiating with a kebab.
lore.legendary: The sacred coals beneath Emberon have never cooled. Every summer storm bends around his grill, terrified of ruining the perfect sear.

names.legendary: Squelchthulhu, Lord of the Bath

lore.common: Collects drips all morning and delivers one freezing wet step just before bedtime.
lore.uncommon: Never dries after a shower. Insists it is developing a personality.
lore.rare: Can swallow a whole puddle without moving. Afterwards it makes the sound of a disappointed duck.
lore.epic: Drank the overflow from an entire swimming pool. The lifeguards spent a week trying to wring it out.
lore.legendary: Legend says every lost bathwater drop eventually reaches Squelchthulhu. Its undersea palace is built entirely from missing bathroom tiles.

names.legendary: Lady Equilibra, Weigher of Everything

lore.common: Flashes an unexpected number when the cat steps on. The cat declines to comment.
lore.uncommon: Beeped at three in the morning and woke the house. It claims the floor gained weight.
lore.rare: Can weigh secrets, promises and missing socks. It refuses to print receipts.
lore.epic: Summoned the entire town for a public weigh-in and declared the mayor's ego heavier than city hall.
lore.legendary: Weighs mountains against feathers without lifting a finger. The only thing Equilibra will never measure is a person's worth.

names.legendary: Lord Uncapulus, Liberator of the Sealed

lore.common: Makes a heroic popping noise whenever it opens a lemonade. Insists on an encore.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the last drawer searched. Has a reserved spot behind the mysterious batteries.
lore.rare: Flicks metal caps into the air like tiny flying saucers. The ceiling has collected fifteen.
lore.epic: Opened an entire festival's drinks with a single flourish. The resulting fizz carried the bandstand into the neighbouring field.
lore.legendary: Uncapulus once freed a genie trapped in a bottle for a thousand years. The grateful genie granted three wishes, all of them for colder drinks.

names.legendary: Dame Beurratrice of the Nevermelting Pat

lore.common: Clings to its own lid with yesterday's butter and calls the struggle a security test.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the butter exactly one degree too cold, no matter how warm the kitchen becomes.
lore.rare: Guards the last golden pat like a dragon guards treasure. Its only weakness is fresh bread.
lore.epic: Declared winter inside its porcelain walls. Every breakfast knife in the kingdom bent trying to enter.
lore.legendary: The last butter dish of a vanished royal bakery, Beurratrice preserves a pat from the first sunrise. It remains perfectly spreadable and is worth more than the palace.

names.legendary: Tortalia, Mother of the Seven Tiers

lore.common: Refuses to release its cake until somebody remembers the clip. It never offers hints.
lore.uncommon: Glues one stubborn corner to the metal and demands a spoon as ransom.
lore.rare: Snaps its springform ring shut on anyone who says the cake is done. Bakers now whisper.
lore.epic: Forged a seven-storey sponge inside its walls. The town council had to inspect the icing for structural integrity.
lore.legendary: Every wedding cake of the ancient kings was born inside Tortalia. Some still wander the world, enormous and frosted, seeking their missing marzipan crowns.

names.legendary: Crankasaurus, Opener of Forbidden Tins

lore.common: Goes round a can once and pretends the lid is still attached for comedic effect.
lore.uncommon: Slips off the rim at the precise moment everyone agrees dinner is nearly ready.
lore.rare: Opens sealed cans from the inside. The baked beans are considering witness protection.
lore.epic: Unsealed every tin in the supermarket at midnight and built a rattling fortress of empty lids. Breakfast was declared a disaster area.
lore.legendary: Crankasaurus once opened a tin sealed before the invention of time. Inside was a single pea, a handwritten apology and instructions never to open the next one.

names.legendary: Casseroth, Keeper of a Thousand Suppers

lore.common: Weighs twice as much once dinner is ready. Nobody knows what it ate.
lore.uncommon: Keeps stew bubbling long after the oven turns off, then pretends to be cold when touched.
lore.rare: Breathes through its rattling lid and makes roast potatoes tremble in their skins.
lore.epic: Sank through the banquet table under the weight of its own stew. The family followed the smell down to the cellar.
lore.legendary: Casseroth has simmered the same feast since the age of giants. Every spoonful tastes of someone's happiest Sunday, but the washing-up takes a century.

names.legendary: Meowthazar, Lord of the Empty Bowl

lore.common: Contains fresh food. The cat is offended that the food is touching the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Pushes itself noisily across the kitchen floor at dawn. The cat insists this is music.
lore.rare: Appears empty to cats even when food towers above its rim. The humans are losing their minds.
lore.epic: Summoned every neighbourhood cat for a breakfast tribunal. The verdict: breakfast was late, even though it was served yesterday.
lore.legendary: Meowthazar has swallowed rivers of cream and mountains of fish yet remains, in the eyes of every cat, tragically empty. Its royal decree is simple: more.

names.legendary: Chafurion, Warden of the Last Warm Feast

lore.common: Keeps the scrambled eggs warm while silently judging every guest's breakfast choices.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks its lid like an old castle door whenever somebody takes a third helping.
lore.rare: Maintains the perfect temperature for three days. The sausages have started calling it home.
lore.epic: Lifted its lid at the hotel buffet and released a cloud of steam shaped like the head chef. The diners gave the beans a standing ovation.
lore.legendary: Chafurion tended the endless feast of the wandering kings. His burners never extinguish, but the last sausage has become a sacred relic and cannot be eaten.

names.legendary: The Grand Duke of Unfinished Brie

lore.common: Guards the last cracker like a tiny dragon. Has no idea where it went.
lore.uncommon: Rearranges the wedges so the stinkiest cheese always sits nearest the guests.
lore.rare: Makes everyone take one more bite until the party has forgotten why it gathered.
lore.epic: Raised a fortress of cheddar, camembert and grapes across the banquet table. The wine glasses surrendered first.
lore.legendary: At the Duke's feasts, every cheese ages a century between courses. His guests leave wiser, smellier and mysteriously unable to button their coats.

names.legendary: Sir Shredalot, the Thousand-Toothed

lore.common: Leaves a little snowdrift of cheese beneath its feet and insists it's winter.
lore.uncommon: Has four faces and every single one is annoyed with your knuckles.
lore.rare: Shreds an entire parmesan wheel before anybody can say spaghetti. The pasta is presumed buried.
lore.epic: Grated the mayor's golden statue into cheese-shaped confetti. The pigeons ate three years of municipal investment.
lore.legendary: The Thousand-Toothed carved a mountain into perfect spaghetti toppings. Somewhere in the snowdrift is an entire lost expedition, now expertly seasoned.

names.legendary: Hashivara, the Thousand-Grain Master

lore.common: Drop the last dumpling into the soup precisely when you think you've mastered them.
lore.uncommon: Refuse to work alone. One once spent a week sulking in a drawer until its twin returned.
lore.rare: Can pluck a single grain of rice from a storm. Still struggles with slippery noodles.
lore.epic: Fought a duel over the last dumpling so quickly that the entire restaurant thought it had seen two wooden dragons.
lore.legendary: Hashivara once caught a thousand falling stars between two slender sticks. He set them gently back in the sky, then dropped a piece of tofu straight into his lap.

names.legendary: Panthenea, Mother of the Golden Spiral

lore.common: Makes the first crepe stick. It claims this is a necessary sacrifice.
lore.uncommon: Flicks batter on every sleeve and calls the spots fashionable.
lore.rare: Flips perfectly circular crepes around corners, over shoulders and into unsuspecting mugs.
lore.epic: Tossed a giant pancake high enough to blot out the lunchtime sun. Half the city waited beneath it with plates.
lore.legendary: Spun a single endless crepe around the world's oldest feast table. The guests have never left, and the pan has never needed washing.

names.legendary: Grainfather, Keeper of Every Last Meal

lore.common: Smells permanently of the onion it met in 2014.
lore.uncommon: Slides across the counter whenever a chef attempts to look competent.
lore.rare: Each old knife mark reveals a secret recipe from a cook long forgotten.
lore.epic: Sprouted four sturdy legs and marched out of the kitchen demanding a safer working environment. Every knife went on strike in solidarity.
lore.legendary: Has borne the preparation of a thousand royal feasts without complaint. Its wooden scars now spell the recipe for a dish that can make even a king admit he was wrong.

names.legendary: Gourmandog, Feeder of the Faithful

lore.common: Moves across the kitchen one lick at a time. The floor is covered in skid marks.
lore.uncommon: Rattles at precisely 5:59 and considers one minute late a personal betrayal.
lore.rare: Can summon a hungry hound from three streets away with a single clink.
lore.epic: Declared itself the only restaurant in the neighborhood and attracted every dog in town. The cats began a one-star review campaign.
lore.legendary: Gourmandog's bowl refills whenever a loyal creature returns home. Legends say even the wandering wolves know where to find it on the coldest night.

names.legendary: Matriarch Mudmora, Guardian of Home

lore.common: Greets everyone with WELCOME, then trips them on its curled corner.
lore.uncommon: Eats muddy footprints. Saves the embarrassing ones for visitors.
lore.rare: Remembers every shoe that crossed it and can summon them by size. The slippers are plotting escape.
lore.epic: Spread across the entrance like a living carpet and swallowed the muddy boots of an entire marching band. They finished the parade barefoot.
lore.legendary: Mudmora once guarded the doorway of a village lost beneath the forest. Travelers who wipe their feet upon her still find a warm fire waiting inside.

names.legendary: Grillgor, Master of the Sacred Sear

lore.common: Draws grill marks on anything flat, including the spatula.
lore.uncommon: Steals the first sausage and blames evaporation.
lore.rare: Makes perfect sear stripes on food without touching it. The chef suspects sorcery.
lore.epic: Turned the entire wedding buffet into an indoor barbecue, complete with smoke alarms and a very enthusiastic fire marshal.
lore.legendary: Grillgor learned the secret of the perfect sear from a dragon who could never light a campfire. Its iron plates still carry the dragon's tiny signature.

names.legendary: Shavasana, the Sleeping Mountain

lore.common: Unrolls obediently except for the corners, which enjoy touching your ankles.
lore.uncommon: Steals one sock during every yoga session and calls it a breathing exercise.
lore.rare: Counts sit-ups out loud, but always forgets the last number. Fitness instructors fear it.
lore.epic: Stretched itself across the park for a sunrise yoga class. By the final pose the ducks, dogs and groundskeeper were all meditating in a row.
lore.legendary: Shavasana once persuaded a mountain to lie down and rest its aching peaks. The valley became a meadow, and the mountain has been pressing snooze for a millennium.

names.legendary: Fondurion, the Bottomless Cauldron

lore.common: Greets every bread cube with a bubbling cheese hug. Very few cubes are ever seen again.
lore.uncommon: Steals the bread from every dipping fork and leaves one tiny cheese-covered apology note.
lore.rare: Strings melted cheese between tables until the dining room resembles a spider's web. The spider demands royalties.
lore.epic: Bubbled through a royal banquet and turned every sword into a cheese fondue fork. The knights fought over croutons instead.
lore.legendary: An entire mountain of cheese disappeared into Fondurion's bubbling depths. Once a winter, a lost explorer resurfaces holding a perfectly toasted crouton.

names.legendary: Pomadora, the Tabletop Eden

lore.common: Holds apples, bananas and one orange that nobody wants.
lore.uncommon: Pretends the house keys are an exotic new fruit. The family keeps trying to peel them.
lore.rare: Hides the last ripe banana under an apple and blames an innocent pear.
lore.epic: Sprouted an entire apple orchard from one abandoned pip in the kitchen. The family now harvests breakfast using ladders.
lore.legendary: Every hundred years Pomadora produces a fruit that tastes of someone's happiest memory. The trouble is that the whole village remembers the same birthday cake.

names.legendary: Funnelius, the Storm in a Thimble

lore.common: Funnels juice into a bottle perfectly until someone says the word easy. Then it redecorates the counter.
lore.uncommon: Whispers secrets through its wide mouth and pours them into the wrong ears.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole jug of lemonade and delivered it drop by drop into the mayor's shoe.
lore.epic: A gigantic funnel appeared over the village during the rain. By morning the entire storm had been decanted into the duck pond.
lore.legendary: Funnelius once poured an ocean into a single bottle without losing a drop. Nobody has yet been brave enough to unscrew the cap.

names.legendary: Count Clovula, Terror of the Kitchen

lore.common: Squeezes garlic through tiny holes, and the rest stays stuck inside forever.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its owner smelling like garlic until next Thursday. The soap has given up.
lore.rare: Sneezes little jets of garlic puree whenever someone says they only want a pinch.
lore.epic: Squeezed an entire harvest into a single drop of garlic juice. The cooking competition's judges fled across the county.
lore.legendary: Count Clovula can press a clove so finely that its scent reaches even the deepest vampire crypt. The vampires now deliver him fresh basil in exchange for mercy.

names.legendary: Plancharos, Emperor of the Endless Fry

lore.common: Has room for six pancakes but insists the seventh belongs on the cook's sleeve.
lore.uncommon: Runs hot on one side and cool on the other. The pancakes have formed a queue with complaints.
lore.rare: Flips an entire breakfast without a spatula. The sausage lands perfectly; the chef does not.
lore.epic: Stretched from one end of the village fête to the other, cooking breakfast for everyone at once. The bacon needed its own traffic warden.
lore.legendary: Plancharos warmed the winter feast of a starving mountain kingdom. His great iron surface still bears the imprint of the first pancake, now worshipped as a tiny sun.

names.legendary: Baron Broil, Master of the Last Minute

lore.common: Turns its back on toast for three seconds and returns to find a tiny charcoal monument.
lore.uncommon: Prints perfect stripes on sandwiches, including the ones nobody put under it.
lore.rare: Melts cheese so fast that the bread has to run to catch up.
lore.epic: Toasted every slice at the banquet simultaneously. The smoke formed a crown around the royal chef's head and refused to leave.
lore.legendary: Baron Broil once challenged a dragon to a cooking contest. The dragon won the flames; the Baron won because his cheese stayed perfectly golden.

names.legendary: Coilbert, the Eternal Hearthkeeper

lore.common: Glows red for ages after dinner and acts offended whenever anyone calls it slow.
lore.uncommon: Warms one lonely saucepan with the pride of a five-star kitchen.
lore.rare: Recognises every pan by its weight and refuses to heat the one that burnt last week's noodles.
lore.epic: Cooked a seven-course wedding feast on a single burner. By the time dessert arrived, the guests had become grandparents.
lore.legendary: When an ancient monastery froze beneath the snow, Coilbert kept its last red ring burning for forty winters. Monks still leave it a tiny copper saucepan each spring.

names.legendary: Inductra, Mistress of the Invisible Fire

lore.common: Beeps furiously when someone rests a spoon on its immaculate black surface.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to heat a pot unless the pot politely introduces itself first.
lore.rare: Boils water in seconds but leaves the glass cool enough for a very confused housefly to sit on.
lore.epic: Declared every pan in the kitchen unsuitable on Christmas Day. The family held a tribunal while the turkey got cold.
lore.legendary: Inductra learned the ancient art of heating iron without flame. Once she warmed the king's last meal through a stone table while a thousand candles burned out around her.

names.legendary: Domelord Charcoal, King of the Coals

lore.common: Looks like a beetle wearing a metal hat. The family is too hungry to mention it.
lore.uncommon: Blows smoke at the clean washing and calls the scent outdoor perfume.
lore.rare: Rolls itself across the patio in pursuit of the only guest who asked for a salad.
lore.epic: Clamped its lid shut during a neighbourhood cookout and held the sausages hostage until the crowd sang its favourite barbecue song.
lore.legendary: Domelord Charcoal cooks beneath a dome said to hold the last ember of the first summer. Even in a blizzard, its grill marks appear on the snow in perfect stripes.

names.legendary: Libra Crumb, Judge of All Measures

lore.common: Adds one mysterious gram whenever someone looks away.
lore.uncommon: Switches off the instant the flour hits the bowl, and pretends it was an accident.
lore.rare: Can weigh a single sigh. The results are never flattering.
lore.epic: Refused to round up a wedding cake recipe and demanded exactly one millionth of a raisin. The ceremony ran late, but the cake was perfect.
lore.legendary: Libra Crumb once weighed the silence between two clock ticks. It was so heavy that time stood still until the baker finished measuring the sugar.

names.legendary: Madame Revolva, Queen of the Feast

lore.common: Spins the salt away every time someone stretches out a hand.
lore.uncommon: Puts the mustard in front of the only person who asked for ketchup.
lore.rare: Whirls the dipping sauces until each one finds itself with a different owner.
lore.epic: Spun during a royal banquet and swapped every guest's dinner with a neighbouring plate. By dessert, the king was eating the stableboy's peas and asking for more.
lore.legendary: Madame Revolva once spun an entire feast so smoothly that time turned with the table. Guests aged no older until the last pudding was served, though the custard grew legendary.

names.legendary: Lady Brimwick, Who Measured Sunrise

lore.common: Pretends the scratched lines on its side are perfectly clear. The cake disagrees.
lore.uncommon: Carries the smell of yesterday's sugar into today's flour and insists it improves the recipe.
lore.rare: Adds a sneaky extra spoonful to every measurement, making all the biscuits suspiciously enormous.
lore.epic: Measured the village bake sale with such generous precision that one cake rose through the roof of the town hall.
lore.legendary: Lady Brimwick once measured a cup of dawn, three spoons of moonlight and a dash of courage. The resulting bread warmed a winter village for seven nights.

names.legendary: Argentum, the Bowl of a Thousand Feasts

lore.common: Shows the baker a face so stretched and silly that the biscuits come out laughing.
lore.uncommon: Scuttles across the countertop when somebody whisks too hard. Insists this is a dance, not a spill.
lore.rare: Rings like a cathedral bell when tapped with a spoon. The neighbour's dog now knows exactly when cake is coming.
lore.epic: Spun a storm of flour and eggs across the banquet kitchen. When the cloud cleared, every guest was wearing a perfectly baked pastry hat.
lore.legendary: Argentum caught the first sunrise in its polished belly and whisked it into a golden batter. The cakes baked from it shine whenever a hungry traveller approaches.

names.legendary: Basalt & Bramble, the Twin Alchemists

lore.common: The bowl and its pestle argue about who does more work. They agree only that garlic smells wonderful.
lore.uncommon: Clunks with the rhythm of a marching band whenever someone crushes herbs.
lore.rare: Grinds rosemary until the whole house smells like an enchanted hillside. The neighbours start walking in their sleep.
lore.epic: Pounded a handful of basil so fiercely that every plant in the greenhouse began dancing. The tomatoes haven't stopped applauding.
lore.legendary: Basalt and Bramble once ground the perfume of a lost forest into a single green paste. One drop can make a barren stone remember the trees that grew there.

names.legendary: Sir Slidewell, Master of Endless Desks

lore.common: Collects coffee rings and meeting doodles, then displays them as modern art.
lore.uncommon: Rolls its corner up exactly where the mouse needs to go next.
lore.rare: Gives the cursor such a slippery ride that clicking the correct button becomes a competitive sport.
lore.epic: Stretched across every desk in the office, joining them into one giant track for a midnight mouse race. The keyboards took bets.
lore.legendary: Slidewell once offered a desktop mouse a perfect glide and carried it straight into the digital horizon. The cursor returned three days later with a postcard from the far side of the screen.

names.legendary: Lady Bunforge, Keeper of the Dozen

lore.common: Gives eleven muffins a perfect shape and makes the twelfth resemble a worried potato.
lore.uncommon: Clings to the bottom of every cake unless someone asks it very politely to let go.
lore.rare: Bakes a row of muffins so tall they form a single sweet wall. The baker needs a saw and a hungry helper.
lore.epic: Forged a hundred towering muffins in one enchanted baking. Their tops marched across the kitchen like a delicious army of hats.
lore.legendary: Lady Bunforge baked twelve golden muffins for the twelve sleeping guardians of an old kingdom. Each woke with a different power and crumbs in its beard.

names.legendary: Clipclaw, Barber of the Sleeping Giant

lore.common: Clicks once and launches a tiny clipping into an undiscovered dimension behind the bathroom sink.
lore.uncommon: Leaves one fingernail perfectly neat and makes the next look like a mountain range.
lore.rare: Trims all ten nails before its owner has finished deciding which hand to start with.
lore.epic: Went wild during the royal manicure and clipped every fingernail in the palace at once. The guards thought hail was hitting the windows.
lore.legendary: Clipclaw climbed the hand of a sleeping mountain giant and trimmed its nails into ten shining shields. The village knights still carry them to battle.

names.legendary: Admiral Crackwell of the Winter Feast

lore.common: Splits the walnut perfectly and scatters the shells under the sofa.
lore.uncommon: Turns a neat walnut into crumbs and says that's just how the chef ordered it.
lore.rare: Breaks the toughest shell without disturbing the little treasure inside. The squirrels consider this cheating.
lore.epic: Cracked an entire banquet's walnuts in one enormous snap. The flying shells formed a storm that sent the guests scrambling beneath the table.
lore.legendary: Admiral Crackwell sailed a fleet of walnut-shell boats through the frozen canals to carry winter food to a starving village. His flagship was barely bigger than a teacup.

names.legendary: Don Socarrat, Furnace of the Festival

lore.common: Takes up three burners and still thinks the kitchen is too small.
lore.uncommon: Has two handles that demand a different helper each time dinner is served.
lore.rare: Forges a saffron crust so fine that the cooks whisper before breaking it.
lore.epic: Became the village square's official cooking arena, so vast that the chefs communicated across it by semaphore. The rice was worth the wait.
lore.legendary: Don Socarrat survived a hundred harvest festivals without losing his shape. The last great feast was cooked in his iron belly, and its aroma drew travellers across the mountains.

names.legendary: Thundermash, Herald of the First Feast

lore.common: Rolls off the kitchen counter and lands exactly where the cook's foot will be.
lore.uncommon: Pounds peppercorns into dust and wears the dust like a very dramatic beard.
lore.rare: Strikes the mortar with a rhythm that makes every spice jar dance out of its cupboard.
lore.epic: Pounded a festival's worth of herbs in one mighty blow. The fragrant shockwave sent every hungry guest running to the wrong village.
lore.legendary: Thundermash ground the first mountain pepper into a powder that awakened a sleeping stone giant. The giant politely requested seconds and became the world's first chef.

names.legendary: Pawpact, Keeper of the Shared Feast

lore.common: Rattles against the kitchen tiles with each enthusiastic lick.
lore.uncommon: Makes a tiny clink that summons every hungry animal in the neighbourhood.
lore.rare: Hides a favourite treat beneath the biscuits and reveals it only to the politest snout.
lore.epic: Rang its metal rim at midnight and called every pet in town to a feast. The humans woke to an empty supermarket pet aisle.
lore.legendary: Pawpact once served a starving wolf and a frightened rabbit from the same bowl. Their unlikely friendship is still celebrated every winter at the forest's great supper.

names.legendary: Lady Piebelle of the Seven Golden Crusts

lore.common: Keeps one delicious blob of pastry stuck to its rim after every wash.
lore.uncommon: Hides a little ceramic bird beneath the crust and whistles when the filling starts bubbling.
lore.rare: Bakes a crust so crisp that the first forkful rings like a church bell.
lore.epic: Baked a savoury pie whose crust rose into an enormous arena. Two rival armies settled their dispute with an apple-throwing contest inside.
lore.legendary: Lady Piebelle baked seven golden pies for a starving village using one handful of flour. Each dish emerged full again whenever a neighbour had been fed.

names.legendary: Mashilda, Keeper of the Cloud-Soft Feast

lore.common: Misses one lumpy corner of every potato and calls it texture.
lore.uncommon: Thumps the saucepan so loudly that the dinner guests start clapping in time.
lore.rare: Turns an entire sack of potatoes into a perfectly smooth mound with one push.
lore.epic: Mashed the whole harvest for the harvest festival. The resulting fluffy mountain swallowed the gravy boat, the peas and the mayor's hat.
lore.legendary: Mashilda prepared a feast for a hundred exhausted travellers using potatoes as hard as stones. Her silver masher turned them into a cloud of warm food that brought everyone back to their feet.

names.legendary: Ramequinn, Chalice of the Golden Crust

lore.common: Holds a single spoonful of pudding and calls it a banquet.
lore.uncommon: Gets so hot in the oven that the chef has to approach wearing two mittens.
lore.rare: Protects its souffle from collapsing with a tiny invisible umbrella.
lore.epic: Grew a caramel crust across an entire bakery, trapping every dessert beneath one enormous crackling roof.
lore.legendary: Ramequinn crowned a perfect creme brulee with a crust harder than castle stone. The knights broke three swords before Grandmother cracked it with a teaspoon.

names.legendary: Roastrum, Keeper of the Sunday Flame

lore.common: Sneaks a hot potato into its corner and refuses to give it back until dinner is cold.
lore.uncommon: Collects roasting juices like treasure; the dog has been appointed official auditor.
lore.rare: Turns an ordinary parsnip into a golden, crackling sceptre. Every roast potato bows to it.
lore.epic: Roasted a banquet so fiercely that the kitchen walls turned into Yorkshire pudding. The guests ate their way to the door.
lore.legendary: Roastrum forged the first Sunday dinner in a furnace beneath a volcano. Its gravy still flows uphill whenever a family gathers around the table.

names.legendary: Oakleaf, the Bowl That Dreamed of Trees

lore.common: Tastes faintly of last week's vinaigrette, no matter what goes into it.
lore.uncommon: Absorbs so much olive oil that its grain begins shining like a polished throne.
lore.rare: Sprouts a tiny branch whenever the cook promises to eat more vegetables.
lore.epic: Grew roots across the dining table during the harvest feast. By dessert, the guests were eating beneath a full-grown oak canopy.
lore.legendary: Oakleaf was carved from the oldest tree in the valley. Each spring it grows one new ring inside its wooden belly, and on the hundredth spring the lost forest will grow around it again.

names.legendary: Whirlista, Mistress of the Flying Greens

lore.common: Rattles the lettuce around so fiercely that every leaf gets a little seasick.
lore.uncommon: Sprays a fine mist of water onto the cook exactly when the washing is finished.
lore.rare: Separates every water droplet from a lettuce leaf and spins the droplets into tiny glassy beads.
lore.epic: Escaped the kitchen counter during a family barbecue and whirled through the garden, raining spinach over the neighbours' washing.
lore.legendary: Whirlista spun a whole greenhouse so fast that the lettuce rose like flying saucers. When actual aliens landed to complain, she served them an enormous salad.

names.legendary: Lidwig, the Crown That Fits Everything

lore.common: Begins rattling like a tiny drum whenever the cook turns away from the boiling potatoes.
lore.uncommon: Collects steam beneath its glass top and hides the dinner until it is too late to change it.
lore.rare: Catches an escaping cloud of soup and squeezes every drop back into the pan.
lore.epic: Blocked an entire flying trifle during a royal kitchen fight. The lid rang like a church bell, and the jelly bounced off the curtains.
lore.legendary: Lidwig fits every pot ever forged, even the cauldrons of giants. Once he crowned a volcano to stop its boiling soup from spilling onto a village.

names.legendary: Justina, the Scale That Weighed a Wish

lore.common: Takes three attempts to decide how much a potato weighs and still looks doubtful.
lore.uncommon: Adds a mysterious extra gram whenever the baker boasts about precision.
lore.rare: Weighs a secret and makes the needle tremble until its owner confesses.
lore.epic: Weighed the royal banquet before anyone could eat. The cake registered as heavier than the entire palace, and the chef demanded a recount.
lore.legendary: Justina weighed a feather against the promise of a king and watched the promise sink the pan. Since then the royal court has been very careful about what it swears.

names.legendary: Gratiana, the Never-Empty Host

lore.common: Hides the last potato beneath three leaves of lettuce to see who gets desperate first.
lore.uncommon: Slides around the dinner table by itself, stopping only beside whoever said they were full.
lore.rare: Doubles every helping it receives, until the family has to invite both neighbours and a passing football team.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire wedding buffet and served it again in five perfectly matching courses. The caterer demanded to see its kitchen.
lore.legendary: Gratiana hosted a feast for a thousand wandering spirits in an empty hall. Each guest found their childhood favourite inside her porcelain heart, and nobody had to wash up.

names.legendary: Trayvella, Bearer of the Impossible

lore.common: Tilts just enough to send one biscuit skidding into the tea.
lore.uncommon: Delivers breakfast to the wrong bedroom every morning. The dog has never eaten better.
lore.rare: Carries a tower of full cups up a spiral staircase without spilling a drop, then bows with its handles.
lore.epic: Floated above a royal banquet balancing forty steaming dishes while the entire kitchen staff chased it with napkins.
lore.legendary: Trayvella carried the last feast across a crumbling sky bridge, one cup at a time. When the bridge fell, she kept walking on the scent of freshly brewed tea.

names.legendary: Smolderick, Last Ember Chef

lore.common: Blows fragrant smoke into the neighbour's washing and insists the shirts smell delicious.
lore.uncommon: Steals a handful of applewood chips when no one is watching, then sulks until given more.
lore.rare: Transforms even plain vegetables into a feast with one curl of fragrant smoke.
lore.epic: Filled the barbecue competition with a cloud of hickory mist so thick that the judges followed their noses and ended up at the wrong pavilion.
lore.legendary: Smolderick learned the art of gentle fire from the oldest oak in the forest. His embers can cook a feast through three sunsets without scorching a crumb or rushing a guest.

names.legendary: Baozara, Keeper of the Hidden Feast

lore.common: Clings to the bottom of every dumpling and won't let go until bribed with cabbage.
lore.uncommon: Wears a bamboo lid like a hat and disappears whenever somebody looks for the tongs.
lore.rare: Stacks itself so high that the topmost dumplings arrive on a different floor of the restaurant.
lore.epic: Raised a swaying tower of steaming bamboo baskets above the night market, feeding the entire crowd by lowering buns on silk strings.
lore.legendary: Baozara guards a banquet hidden in the clouds. Each time the mist lifts from a mountain, one perfectly steamed dumpling falls into a lucky traveller's hands.

names.legendary: Consomara, Cook of the Seven Harvests

lore.common: Simmers on the stove for so long that the carrots start telling stories.
lore.uncommon: Hides an entire afternoon's steam inside its lid, then releases it when someone leans in.
lore.rare: Makes soup from the smell of ingredients alone. The chef calls it efficient; the vegetables call it suspicious.
lore.epic: Filled with stew until it grew legs and marched into the town square to feed every hungry person at the winter fair.
lore.legendary: Consomara gathered one vegetable from every harvest of seven kingdoms. Her stockpot never empties, but each bowl tastes like the eater's happiest homecoming.

names.legendary: Caldera Cook, Keeper of the Blue Flame

lore.common: Turns on the wrong ring exactly when the cook has already filled the kettle.
lore.uncommon: Clicks twelve times before lighting and then pretends it was a deliberate dramatic entrance.
lore.rare: Controls four burners independently, cooking the perfect dinner while conducting the pots like an orchestra.
lore.epic: Made every hob in the city flare into a blue symphony at once, and the cooks served a banquet before anybody had finished chopping.
lore.legendary: Caldera Cook has guarded the tiny blue flame beneath a mountain kitchen for a thousand years. Even when the volcano slept, the village never went hungry.

names.legendary: Lady Melispoon of the Endless Refill

lore.common: Leaves a sticky ring on every table and calls it a signature.
lore.uncommon: Hosts a morning meeting for ants on its rim. The sugar tax is being discussed.
lore.rare: Transforms wet spoons into crystal stirrers and hides them from the dishwasher.
lore.epic: Swapped the salt and sugar at a grand feast, triggering a diplomatic incident over the dessert course.
lore.legendary: Lady Melispoon served tea to seven generations from the same tiny dish, replenishing every lost lump with a pearl of crystallised moonlight.

names.legendary: Tajinara, Flame Beneath the Clay

lore.common: Hides beneath its conical lid and sniffs the stew whenever no one is looking.
lore.uncommon: Releases aromatic steam only for those who lift the lid politely.
lore.rare: Stews for so long that its fragrant vapour makes passing travellers dream of home.
lore.epic: Raised a towering spiral of saffron-scented steam above a desert banquet, guiding a lost caravan straight to the feast.
lore.legendary: Tajinara kept the last cooking flame alive through a desert winter beneath a cone of painted clay. Every meal she prepares tastes faintly of reunion.

names.legendary: Clackathor, the Hands of the Feast

lore.common: Clicks twice before picking up a sausage. It's a professional ritual.
lore.uncommon: Waits until dinner is served, then drops the last sausage onto the floor.
lore.rare: Grasps invisible food from across the room and transports it to the cook's plate without asking.
lore.epic: Clacked a mighty warning at the seaside barbecue and summoned every crab in the bay. Guests found themselves served by a crab army.
lore.legendary: Clackathor once carried a flaming feast across a bridge of glass without losing a single pea. The royal chefs still bow whenever metal tongs click in the kitchen.

names.legendary: Tweezaria, the Hand That Held a Star

lore.common: Drops the eyelash it was supposed to pick up and looks deeply insulted.
lore.uncommon: Closes around a stubborn splinter and brings up everything except the splinter.
lore.rare: Picks a single glitter speck from a mountain of sand without disturbing another grain.
lore.epic: Plucked a loose thread from a giant's coat and unravelled an enormous tapestry of clouds, revealing a blue sky the village had forgotten.
lore.legendary: Tweezaria was made to hold the smallest fragment of a fallen star while the sky was repaired. Her tips still glow whenever something precious has been overlooked.

names.legendary: Shanti, the Mat of Seven Breaths

lore.common: Rolls itself up the instant its owner reaches the most difficult pose.
lore.uncommon: Makes a dramatic squeak whenever someone attempts to look peaceful.
lore.rare: Turns the loudest room silent for seven breaths, though the dog always sneezes on the eighth.
lore.epic: Guru Rollasaurus unrolled across an entire rush-hour railway platform. Hundreds of commuters accidentally performed a perfect sun salutation and missed their trains with impressive calm.
lore.legendary: Shanti lay beneath a restless monastery for a hundred years. One morning she taught the bells to ring without sound; the monks heard them anyway and finally understood how to rest.
